title: 2024 USAMO Problem 5
statement: Point \(D\) is selected inside acute triangle \(ABC\) so that \(\angle DAC=\angle ACB\) and \(\angle BDC=90^\circ+\angle BAC\). Point \(E\) is chosen on ray \(BD\) so that \(AE=EC\). Let \(M\) be the midpoint of \(BC\). Show that line \(AB\) is tangent to the circumcircle of triangle \(BEM\).

solutions.text:
Let \(\angle DBT = \alpha\) and \(\angle BEM = \beta\). Extend AD intersects BC at point T, then TC = TA, TE is perpendicular to AC

Thus, AB is the tangent of the circle BEM

Then the question is equivalent as the \(\angle ABT\) is the auxillary angle of \(\angle BEM\).
